text.en: Heidemarie Linked and Quietus
[Linked] [Quietus] 80% Damage × 2. Attunement: Create 2 Effulgent Blade.
[Linked] [Quietus] Draw 3. Apply Linked to those cards for this turn.
[Linked] 120% Damage. When this card is Discarded, 120% Extra Attack to a random enemy. This card does not move to Draw Pile on Shuffle.
[Unactivatable] [Unique] [Linked] [Retrieve 3] When moved to Graveyard, 1 Effulgent Light.

body.en:
Linked is Hide's main Mechanic
If Cards are Linked together that means
If one of the Linked cards are used, the rest are discarded
The discard happens on cast, not on card resolution
So you cannot use a Linked card, then try to affect another Linked card
This does make Nia a bit more unfortunate with Hero to All
Effulgent Blades Compression and Release

[Unique] 500% Damage. Exhaust all Effulgent Blade in Graveyard, then +100% base Damage Amount for each Exhausted. At the end of the turn, change this card into Effulgent Compression.

body.en:
Effulgent Blades are Heide's main created cards
They can be discarded for Extra Attack Damage
But the main fact about them is how they infinitly stack inside your Discard Pile
While not bricking and filling your draw pile reshuffles
Effulgent Compression once turned into Release becomes a MASSIVE NUKE
That scales based on the amount of Effulgent Blades you have in discard pile
